title: mlx-performance-profiler procedure comparison record, schema version 1
description: Written as <report_file_base>.json by mlx_perf_compare_procedures_to_report: every round of both procedures, the verdicts on duration, GPU busy and GPU idle time, and each procedure's kernel launches by Metal function.

duration_us.description: From run() starting until every command buffer it committed completed.

gpu_busy_us.description: Time inside the run when at least one of its command buffers was on the GPU.

gpu_idle_us.description: duration_us - gpu_busy_us: the GPU had nothing of the procedure's to do.

command_buffer_count.description: Command buffers MLX committed during the run.

blocking_wait_count.description: Evals and synchronizes that blocked the host until the GPU finished.

blocking_wait_us.description: Host time spent in those waits.

memory.description: Read just before and just after the run, outside its timing (#46).

peak_mlx_active_bytes.description: MLX's peak active memory during the run.

peak_mlx_active_added_bytes.description: That peak less MLX's active memory at the run's start: the run's own working set.

mlx_held_at_end_bytes.description: MLX active + cache at the end.

mlx_held_change_bytes.description: MLX active + cache at the end less at the start: what the run left behind; may be negative.

wire_requests_over_limit_count.description: Wire requests the kernel refused over the limit during the run; null when unreadable.

compressed_bytes.description: Bytes the system compressed during the run (any program's); null when unreadable.

swap_used_change_bytes.description: Change in swap in use; null when unreadable.

rounds.description: One run per round, in round order.

observed_run.description: The extra run that recorded kernel launches; not judged.

metal_function_name.description: The Metal function, or "(unnamed pipeline)" for pipelines compiled before the recorder was installed.

lowest_gpu_core_coverage.description: Threadgroups over GPU cores, at most 1, for the smallest launch; null when the core count is unknown.

has_launch_unable_to_fill_gpu.description: Whether any launch had fewer threadgroups than GPU cores; null when the core count is unknown.

kernel_launches.description: The observed run's launches grouped by Metal function.

wired_memory.description: The system's wired memory beside MLX's (#45); null when no samples were taken.

released_sample_index.description: The first sample that saw MLX's holding fall.

unwired_sample_index.description: The first sample whose wired total had fallen by half the release; null when none did.

release_lag_us.description: From released_sample_index to unwired_sample_index; null when unresolved.

system_wired_bytes.description: The system's wired total (vm.page_wired_count times the page size).

wire_headroom_bytes.description: wire_limit_bytes - system_wired_bytes; null when the limit is unknown.

difference_interval_us.description: Distribution-free interval for the median per-round difference (12 rounds: 3rd and 10th smallest, coverage 0.961).

sign_test_p_value.description: Exact two-sided sign test over non-zero per-round differences.

median_difference_us.description: Median per-round difference; negative means the candidate is faster.

relative_difference.description: median_difference_us / baseline median (0 when that is 0).

verdict.description: candidate_faster when the whole interval lies below zero, candidate_slower when above, otherwise within_spread: no result.
